verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. beads_export_records now parses every candidate timestamp before comparison, skips unusable values, and compares timezone-aware instants rather than raw strings, so a lexicographically large malformed stamp cannot suppress valid stale-export evidence. The focused tests cover both direct winner selection and the end-to-end stale trigger with no missing-reference fallback, and also verify ordering across UTC offsets. The change is coherent and complete within the diff-scoped scanner behavior.
